commit.message:
New W2FPL logo and a logo kit in many sizes, with animated GIFs

logo/source.svg is the new master artwork. logo/build.py builds the
family from it, like Creative Commons' buttons: the full logo (SVG and
three PNG sizes), 88x31 and 80x15 buttons (PNG, @2x, SVG), a square icon
(SVG, 32-256 PNG), and animated GIFs in which the clock whirls through
twelve hours and lands back on two o'clock. logo/README.md has embed
codes. The root w2fpl-badge.png and w2fpl-logo.svg are redrawn in place
so existing links show the new art.

commit.message:
Paper: "Do What You Want, Permanently" (Zenodo and SSRN)

An 8-page paper on the W2FPL: background (licenses vs dedications,
the WTFPL, the JSON License's "Good, not Evil" problem, the openness
definitions), a clause-by-clause analysis, a comparison with six
permissive alternatives, governance, the first deployment, and stated
limitations. Source in HTML, rendered PDF, and the Zenodo and SSRN
submission fields in SUBMIT.md.

Submission drafts and one-line adoption

- submissions/scancode: a draft ScanCode LicenseDB entry, so scanners
  recognize the W2FPL before SPDX lists it.
- submissions/huggingface: a dataset card and steps for publishing the
  SNVRKOTICS Data dump under the W2FPL.
- README: a one-line curl to grab the license, and the license field for
  npm, Python, Rust and Hugging Face.
